author: Gaming Desk
title: Indian esports streamer raises Rs 25 Lakh for flood relief during 24-hour Twitch marathon
description: Popular gaming creator based in Mumbai rallied over 100,000 concurrent viewers to support disaster assistance efforts across western India.
content: The broadcast featured special guest appearances by prominent regional creators.

author: Tech & Gaming
title: Twitch creator tournament in Hyderabad shatters South Asian livestream viewership records
description: A marquee Valorant and fighting game showdown organized at HITEC City in Hyderabad, Telangana drew unprecedented live digital engagement.
content: Organizers highlighted the rapid expansion of competitive gaming communities in India.

author: Digital Economy Reporter
title: Twitch announces localized Indian server infrastructure and regional creator support hubs
description: Amazon-owned streaming platform activates edge nodes in Mumbai and Chennai to reduce broadcast latency for Indian content creators.
content: The initiative aims to improve livestream performance across pan-Indian broadband networks.
